content.Title: 2021 ACC/AHA/SCAI Coronary Revascularization Guideline

Sections.Title: 15.2. Smoking Cessation in Patients After Revascularization
Content: Discusses the importance of smoking cessation and various interventions.
References studies on pharmacotherapy and behavioral interventions for smoking cessation.

Sections.Title: 15.3. Psychological Interventions in Patients After Revascularization
Content: Includes references to clinical trials and studies on effects of psychological therapies.

References: A comprehensive list of references supporting the guidelines, including meta-analyses, systematic reviews, and expert consensus documents.
